scope: Official documentation plus read-only review of supplied licensed ShaderWorld4.1 source. No editor, game, build, save, GPU-export or new persistence test executed. This report contains observations and project proposals, not plugin source.

observations.finding: Named producer, generator material, format and filter. Default RGBA8/Nearest; discrete IDs and blend weights are discussed in source. These are spatial GPU layers, not a disk database.
Destination path, transient export trigger and empty TerrainStorage class; no implemented persistent save/load contract found in this class.
Cache tiles are sought, but the inspected write section is unimplemented; function may still return true. Success return is not proof of an applied or persistent edit.
Render-target export with transient RGBA8 intermediate, dimensions below4097. No disk save; positive wrapper result does not prove every inner export succeeded.

Transient GPU outputs: world height R32F, normals/layers RGBA16F; up to4096 samples per axis. Requires supported segmented terrain and ready world/shaders/tiles; retry state is explicit. No OverTime ocean path or persistence guarantee.
Inspected AddData, UpdateBounds, UpdateHierarchy and RebuildMips helpers are empty. No working tile persistence inferred from their names.
Located SavePackage paths belong to editor asset import. Import method uses WITH_EDITOR; texture-source construction uses WITH_EDITORONLY_DATA. Not a runtime packaged-game world-save contract.
Only base serialization invoked in inspected overrides; no custom GPU pixel or world-edit persistence contract established. Does not claim every possible serializer was exhaustively audited.

documentation_sources.claim: Manufacturer describes runtime data alongside terrain, including biome/material and environmental values.
Brush example writes layer values consumed by terrain material.
Cached generation, producers and spawnable layer consumption; collectable resource bookkeeping is not provided by default.

project_decision.terrain_layers: Regenerable spatial projection for soil, moisture, construction masks and related display/spawn rules. Proposed uses, not newly tested.
project_decision.authoritative_save: Stable entities, plan revisions, completed work, integer-gram accounts, machine and truck state remain in own versioned persistence.
project_decision.editor_map: Authored start world can contain configured actors/assets. Runtime changes are not thereby proven to be written back into the umap.
project_decision.future_checkpoints: Consider regional snapshots only after a bounded reconstruction/cold-restart/cooked test and performance measurement.

not_tested: Additional custom data layer and brush integration
Durability across region eviction and cold restart
Crash recovery, commit atomicity or migration of new regional snapshots
